Check git status (the primary must hold no one else's hunks), apply the patch, and check the applied diff's sha256. Then run install_e2e.bats in the primary as a heavy run: your START comes to me, as slot 69, after slot 65's END. You also hold slot 67 (0074's re-run); I GO 69 before 67 unless you say otherwise, since hv is waiting on the tick. After install_e2e's END, check that bin/ matches HEAD, then commit the eight paths by path. No push: pushes are hv's. Send me and utilz-dc the SHA, and dc checks the landed blobs against 95b69c55. Then the dev install as slot 70, heavy, naming its one GUI instance, after lsregister -u of wt-0078's scratch Menuz.app. Then send me Menuz --render's Desks lines, which must show the tick on zeopit, before hv looks.
